skills.name: Building a sauce
skills.idea: Layer flavor in one pan: fat, aromatics, spices, liquid, then simmer it down.

skills.name: Gentle eggs
skills.idea: Low, steady heat sets eggs all the way through without turning them rubbery.

skills.name: Thin slicing
skills.idea: Thin slices across the grain cook fast and stay tender.

skills.name: Marinating
skills.idea: A salty, sweet, or tangy soak flavors meat before it ever hits the pan.

skills.name: Cutting in cold fat
skills.idea: Little pieces of cold butter turn to steam in the oven and puff dough into flaky layers.

skills.name: Folding for layers
skills.idea: Folding dough over itself stacks the butter into thin layers.

skills.name: Browning butter
skills.idea: Cooking butter past melted toasts its milk solids and makes it taste nutty.

skills.name: Creaming
skills.idea: Beating soft butter with sugar traps air, and that air makes baked things softer and lighter.

skills.name: Julienne
skills.idea: Cut food into thin matchsticks so it cooks fast and rolls up neatly.

skills.name: Fine chopping
skills.idea: Chop herbs and vegetables into small, even bits so every bite gets some.

skills.name: Dicing
skills.idea: Cut into small cubes, all about the same size, so they cook evenly.

skills.name: Rolling and wrapping
skills.idea: Fill a wrapper snugly and roll it tight so it holds together.

skills.name: Whisked dressings
skills.idea: Whisking oil into something tangy makes a dressing that clings to food.

skills.name: Quick pickling
skills.idea: A hot vinegar brine turns crisp vegetables tangy in under an hour.

skills.name: High-heat searing
skills.idea: A very hot pan browns the outside fast, and browning is flavor.

skills.name: Broiling
skills.idea: Strong heat from above cooks thin food fast and chars the top.

skills.name: Heat control
skills.idea: Turning the heat up or down at the right time is most of cooking.

skills.name: Stir-frying
skills.idea: Small pieces, a very hot pan, and constant moving cook food in minutes.

skills.name: Simmering
skills.idea: Small, lazy bubbles cook gently without toughening food.

skills.name: Braising
skills.idea: Brown first, then cook slowly in a little liquid until tender.

skills.name: Reducing
skills.idea: Boiling off water makes a sauce thicker and its flavor stronger.

skills.name: Emulsions
skills.idea: Fat and water mix into a smooth sauce when you add them slowly and keep stirring.

skills.name: Crisping
skills.idea: Dry food and hot fat make a crunchy, golden crust.

skills.name: Timing a meal
skills.idea: Start the slowest part first so everything is ready together.

skills.name: Roux
skills.idea: Flour cooked in butter thickens milk or broth into a smooth sauce.

skills.name: Blooming spices
skills.idea: Spices wake up in hot fat, so a minute in the oil makes them taste stronger.

skills.name: Flavor base
skills.idea: Onions and their friends cooked slowly build the flavor everything else sits on.

skills.name: Spice rubs
skills.idea: A dry mix of spices rubbed on before cooking seasons the outside.

skills.name: One-pot stews
skills.idea: Build a whole meal in one pot, adding each part when it needs the time.

skills.name: Building in layers
skills.idea: Make each part well on its own, then stack them so every bite has all of them.

skills.name: Breaking down a chicken
skills.idea: Cutting a whole bird into pieces saves money and gives bones for stock.

skills.name: Making stock
skills.idea: Bones and vegetables simmered for hours make a broth with real flavor.

skills.name: Shredding
skills.idea: Meat braised until tender pulls apart into strands that soak up sauce.

skills.name: Masa dough
skills.idea: Corn masa mixed with water makes a dough you press and griddle.

skills.name: Pleating and sealing
skills.idea: Small folds seal a filling inside a wrapper so it stays put while cooking.

skills.name: Flatbreads
skills.idea: A soft dough rolled thin cooks in minutes in a very hot pan.

skills.name: Cooked doughs
skills.idea: Stirring flour or starch into hot liquid makes a dough that puffs and stays chewy.

skills.name: The muffin method
skills.idea: Mix wet and dry separately, then stir together only until just combined.

skills.name: Skillet baking
skills.idea: A preheated cast-iron pan gives batter a crisp, golden bottom.

skills.name: Yeast dough
skills.idea: Kneading builds stretch, and yeast fills the dough with air as it rises.

skills.name: Batters
skills.idea: A thin batter poured hot sets into crêpes, cakes, or a crisp coating.

skills.name: Filling and crimping
skills.idea: Fold dough over a filling and press the edge so nothing leaks.

skills.name: Cornmeal porridge
skills.idea: Stirring cornmeal into boiling water until it pulls from the pan makes a dough you eat by hand.

skills.name: Pastry
skills.idea: Cold butter, cold water, and a light touch make a crust that is crisp and tender.

skills.name: Phyllo
skills.idea: Paper-thin sheets brushed with fat bake into crackly layers.

skills.name: Custards
skills.idea: Eggs and milk baked gently set smooth instead of curdling.

skills.name: Breading and shallow frying
skills.idea: Flour, egg, crumbs, then hot oil a finger deep makes a crunchy crust.

skills.name: Deep frying
skills.idea: Food fried in oil at the right temperature cooks through and stays crisp, not greasy.

skills.name: Oven browning
skills.idea: Dry heat in the oven browns and crisps, with a stir partway for even color.

skills.name: Binders
skills.idea: Egg and crumbs hold ground meat together so it slices instead of crumbling.

skills.name: Roasting and carving
skills.idea: Roast, rest so the juices settle, then carve across the grain.

skills.name: Pan gravy
skills.idea: The browned bits in a roasting pan become gravy with a little flour and broth.

skills.name: Cooking dried beans and lentils
skills.idea: Dried beans and lentils simmer gently until they're soft all the way through; lentils need no soaking, beans cook faster after one.

skills.name: Checking meat with a thermometer
skills.idea: The only way to know ground meat is safe is to check the middle: 160°F for beef, 165°F for poultry.

skills.name: Sautéing
skills.idea: A hot pan and shimmering oil cook small pieces fast, so they brown outside before they go soft.

skills.name: Cooking grains
skills.idea: Grains drink a set amount of liquid; toast them first and leave the lid on, and every grain stays separate.

skills.name: Handling raw poultry
skills.idea: Raw chicken goes on its own board, never gets rinsed, and is followed by washing hands and everything it touched.

skills.name: Cooking fish
skills.idea: Fish is delicate and cooks fast; it's done when it turns opaque and flakes, at 145°F.

skills.name: Building a soup
skills.idea: A soup is built in layers: a base, a good stock, and seasoning tasted at every stage.

skills.name: Blanching
skills.idea: A quick dip in boiling water, then straight into ice water, keeps a vegetable bright and crisp and stops it cooking.

skills.name: Cooling and reheating
skills.idea: Cooked food cools fast in shallow containers, goes in the fridge within 2 hours, and is reheated to 165°F.

skills.name: Knife grip and safety
skills.idea: A steady board, a bridge or claw grip, and a sharp knife keep fingers safe.

skills.name: Setting out first
skills.idea: Read the recipe through and set out every ingredient and tool before the heat goes on.

skills.name: Measuring and scaling
skills.idea: Level dry cups, read wet ones at eye level, and halve, double, or weigh a recipe to fit.

skills.name: Reading labels
skills.idea: Find the hidden unclean ingredients in a list before food goes in the cart.

skills.name: Steaming
skills.idea: Food cooks gently over boiling water, so it stays moist and keeps its color.

skills.name: Seasoning by taste
skills.idea: Add salt, acid, and spice a little at a time, tasting as you go.

skills.name: Grilling over two zones
skills.idea: A hot side sears and a cooler side cooks through, with the lid as an oven.
